Definition: from G4314 and G154; to ask repeatedly (importune), i.e. solicit:--beg.
BiblicalUsage: Prosaito means to beg, to ask again and again. It appears once, when the neighbours of the blind man ask, Is not this he that sat and begged?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the beggar's old life is the point: everyone knew him by his begging, and no one could deny the change once Jesus opened his eyes.
